name: outlook_open_view
description: Switch the selected Outlook main window by a documented navigation shortcut, then read its actual UI. Numeric view positions can differ by local Outlook configuration; inspect the result.

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Stable observed main-window substring, for example the suffix " - Outlook".

parameters.name: view_key
parameters.description: Documented classic Outlook view key: 1 Mail, 2 Calendar, 3 People, 4 Tasks. Verify the actual resulting view.
